title: Trump Nominates Career Diplomat Devin Kennington as US Ambassador to Somalia
detail: The White House submitted a slate of 41 nominations to the Senate on September 14, 2026, including career diplomat Devin Kennington of California as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to the Federal Republic of Somalia, reported September 15. If confirmed, Kennington would be the first full US ambassador to Mogadishu since Richard H. Riley departed in December 2025 as part of a broader recall of roughly 30 Biden-appointed chiefs of mission across Africa. The US mission in Mogadishu has been led by Chargé d'Affaires Justin Davis since January 15, 2026, with Ruth Anne Stevens-Klitz serving as deputy chief of mission since August 2026. The nomination requires Senate Foreign Relations Committee review; the Trump administration's signaled plans to cut UN and African Union peacekeeping funding in Somalia are expected to shape confirmation discussions.

title: Baidoa District Administration Stages Pro-Turkey Rally After Reported Flag Burning
detail: The Baidoa district administration organized a rally at Dr Ayuub Stadium on September 15, 2026, drawing South West State officials and residents in a show of support for Turkey after reports that the Turkish flag was burned in villages near the city amid the wider wave of anti-Ankara protests over the disputed September 3-4 Doolow strike. Southwest State Security Minister Ishaq Mohamed Korsar told the crowd 'Turkey's support cannot be hidden, and we thank them for it,' and officials accused those responsible for the flag burning of aligning with Al-Shabaab. The rally underscores the split within Somalia's federal member states over the Doolow fallout: Southwest State's administration, aligned with Mogadishu, staged a public rebuttal even as Jubaland and Puntland saw sustained flag-burning protests over the same incident.

media.caption: A pro-Turkey rally at Dr Ayuub Stadium in Baidoa responded to reported Turkish flag burnings nearby, Sep 15, 2026
